verdict.rationale: Supabase explicitly states 'Every project is a full Postgres database, the world's most trusted relational database' (supabase-docs-51), implying standard Postgres connection strings work with any client or ORM, and community users confirm using it as a hosted SQL database with standard tooling. Missing for 10: explicit connection-string documentation, named ORM compatibility (Prisma, Drizzle, etc.), and independent hands-on confirmation of connecting via psql/ORM.
